title: Yiza uzokuhlala nam
description: UMakhulu uFudo kaTendai ulimaze iqokobhe lakhe kwaye uMama noTata kufuneka bahambe bayomkunceda. “Yiza ukuzohlala nam,” utsho umhlobo omkhulu kaTendai uBusi umvundla, lwaze lwaqala ulonwabo.
